name: N8N Mail WORKFLOW Prototype — Error Alert

parameters.content:
## 🚨 Error alert
Attach this workflow to the main one: open **N8N Mail WORKFLOW Prototype → ⋯ → Settings → Error workflow** and pick this workflow. From then on, any failure (invalid Anthropic key, no credit, expired Google login…) sends you a Telegram message instead of failing silently.
Set the Telegram credential and Chat ID in the last node, then **Publish** this workflow.

telegramApi.name: Telegram bot (your own — swap for Slack/Email if preferred)
